notes:
I couldn't gather any sources this time, so I have no commentary notes on Jeremiah 52 to give you.

My first attempt to download the five main pages failed because of a bug in my own script. That used up my web access for this turn before any page content came through, so I never read a word from them. Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, so I haven't written any verse notes from memory.

These are the pages I was trying to read:
- Enduring Word: https://enduringword.com/bible-commentary/jeremiah-52/
- Ellicott: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/jeremiah/52.htm
- Pulpit Commentary: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/pulpit/jeremiah/52.htm
- Gill: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/jeremiah/52.htm
- Precept Austin: https://www.preceptaustin.org/jeremiah-52-commentary

If you ask me to carry on, I'll read those first and then search for the rest:
- **Where traditions differ:** the denominational sites (Ligonier, Desiring God, GTY, Wesley Center, Seedbed, LCMS, 1517 and others).
- **Other views:** NET Bible notes, Bible Odyssey, New Advent, Catholic.com and OCA. I'd look especially at verses 1–3 (God's anger and Zedekiah's rebellion) and verses 28–30, where the exile numbers differ from 2 Kings 24–25. I'd also look at verses 31–34, where Jehoiachin's release is often read as a sign of hope for David's royal line.

Then I'll write the notes verse by verse, with a URL after each point.
